findings.text: saveMetadataFile is a near-verbatim ~75-line copy across Book/Podcast scanners (identical ensureDir/write/timestamp bookkeeping/catch), and the copies have drifted: BookScanner guards `storeMetadataWithItem && !libraryItem.isFile`, PodcastScanner doesn't — needs a helper with media-specific payload.

rescanExistingBookLibraryItem is a ~385-line god-method: audio-file reconciliation, cover/ebook handling, then an inline metadata-diff engine doing per-name DB lookups inside for-loops; BookScanner.js is 1045 LoC. Real maintenance hazard, though the logic is coherent.
scanBookMetadataFile/scanPodcastMetadataFile duplicate file-locating and abMetadata merge logic; open 'TODO: When to override with null or empty arrays?' (line 38) leaves merge semantics provisional.
relPath derived via path.replace(folderPath, '') — substring replace instead of prefix strip; safe today (isSameOrSubPath guard at 279) but real path-handling fragility.
